charts.title: Class of 2030 Ivy League Acceptance Rates (Reported & Estimated)
charts.footnote: Harvard, Princeton, Penn, Dartmouth, and Cornell did not release official Class of 2030 statistics; figures represent best available estimates from student newspapers and institutional data aggregators. Brown figure of 5.35% is from official Brown Daily Herald reporting.

charts.title: Projected Fall 2026 International Enrollment Change by Institution Quartile
charts.footnote: Quartile 1 = largest international enrollment institutions; Quartile 4 = smallest. Graduate enrollment shows consistent declines across all quartiles. Figures represent projected midpoint of reported ranges.

charts.title: Common App International Submissions Decline by Country, 2026-27 Cycle
charts.sourceText: NAFSA / Common App data via NAFSA Fall 2026 Outlook, August 11, 2026
charts.footnote: Year-over-year change in international submissions to Common App member schools for the 2026-27 application cycle. Nigeria is subject to the current U.S. travel ban with no F-1 student exemption.

charts.title: Tiered Endowment Tax Rates Under One Big Beautiful Bill (Effective July 1, 2026)
charts.footnote: Tax applies only to private colleges with at least 3,000 tuition-paying students. Yale is estimated at the 8% tier ($44.2B endowment). Penn falls in the 4% tier. Princeton may fall below the 3,000 tuition-paying student threshold and be exempt. Brown's $7.2B endowment places it in the 4% bracket. Replaces the prior flat 1.4% rate.
